blocking_focus: Camera coverage and shipped framing leave only 0.333 visible Warden samples and the player/threat silhouettes are too small for the required readable high-angle composition.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance build expansion by repairing readable camera and arena traversal while delivering truthful weapon/build choices and authoritative five-wave/Bellkeeper progression.

diagnosis.root_cause: The shipped ArenaCamera profile remains over-distant (high follow height/distance and wide FOV) and its landmark occluder handling leaves only 0.3333 Warden visibility, producing small player/threat silhouettes and gameplay-relevant occlusion. The required increment also lacks verified weapon/build identity and wave-director/boss contracts.

stop_conditions: Keep the preserved AuthoredCemeteryPackage and Warden authored animation bindings intact.
Do not add proxy floors, replacement landmark packs, or unrelated backlog-gap work.
Tester and GameLoop Runtime own recapture, black-box/white-box retests, issue closure, and final gate verdicts.

strategy.rationale: Use three bounded root-cause families: repair the camera/spatial wrapper and sightline composition, synchronize authoritative weapon/build transactions with their HUD, and complete data-driven wave/Bellkeeper lifecycle behavior.

code: Run existing native Godot boot/project-integrity checks and modified-script parse/resource validation.
Exercise weapon inventory, upgrade projection/commit, wave director, boss, and restart state snapshots with focused automated checks where available.
Confirm modified scenes/resources load without missing references or runtime errors.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester recaptures the prior camera coverage route at spawn, ordinary movement, dash, central landmark, and perimeter states, then retests camera_framing_readability with the same framing predicates.

Tester performs black-box weapon equip, automatic attack, level-up draft, keyboard/mouse/gamepad selection, upgrade commit, and post-upgrade combat checks, including authoritative current-to-new values.
Tester runs an ordinary route through Waves 1-5 and Bellkeeper entry/defeat or failure, then verifies Result and Retry produce a clean authoritative snapshot with no continued spawning.
Tester probes enemy spawn safety, collision, boundary containment, player/threat visibility, boss health/telegraphs, and terminal transition counts.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay-camera frames for spawn, critical traversal, dash, central landmark, perimeter, upgrade draft, wave transition, boss entry, and result/retry.

Judge silhouette scale/separation, escape-lane readability, external depth and landmark visibility, authored choice hierarchy, focus states, truthful stat deltas, wave escalation, and boss telegraph/health readability against the bound PRD and survivor-like policy.

done_when: The high-angle gameplay camera keeps the full player, nearby threats, pickups, and at least one escape lane readable at spawn, during traversal, and through dash onset/recovery.

Spatial acceptance is met: expand to a larger traversable scale when needed while retaining a coherent external world/external depth; the central building/landmark remains visible; collision matches visible geometry; no disappearance or gameplay-relevant occlusion occurs; the boundary/perimeter is sealed; ordinary movement and movement replay remain stable.
Camera coverage and runtime screenshots show materially larger player/threat silhouettes than the failing baseline, with no landmark-induced Warden disappearance.
tasks.instructions: Repair the ArenaCamera and CemeterySpatialContract integration as one wrapper/binding problem, not per-mesh transform tuning. Rebase follow height/distance/FOV, lead and dash framing, safe-frame correction, and occluder fade/visibility layers so the player and imminent threats stay in the shipped high-angle view. Validate or expand the outer datum/navigation/collision envelope to provide larger traversable scale around the intact authored cemetery; preserve its external world/depth, central building/landmark composition, native streets, and Warden authored package. Ensure visible geometry and collision agree at the boundary/perimeter and that ordinary movement and movement replay cannot cause pass-through, disappearance, or camera occlusion.
tasks.title: Repair camera framing and arena spatial integrity

done_when: The authoritative build snapshot exposes equipped Warden Lantern, Gravespade, and Wandering Wisps identities, ranks, strategies, and changed runtime stats.

The upgrade catalog contains at least 12 eligible authored upgrades spanning the three weapon identities, movement/dash, survivability, pickup/experience economy, and a risk/reward option; distinct successful ordinary routes can produce focused bolts, close-range sweeps, and orbiting area control.

Automatic attacks are emitted once per cadence for the equipped weapon and an accepted upgrade changes the next relevant combat event; experience overflow, eligibility, stacking, and held-confirm debounce remain correct.

Each of three choices leads with an authored weapon/upgrade silhouette or icon, shows no more than three decision-relevant current-to-new stat deltas, never uses NEW or LOCKED as CURRENT, and exposes distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed/selected states.
tasks.instructions: Synchronize WeaponInventory, weapon runtimes, UpgradeDraftController, and the HUD around authoritative state. Repair weapon unlock/rank and upgrade projection/commit so eligibility, stacking, cooldown/count/area effects, and build identity are truthful and observable in combat. Refine the existing upgrade-draft view into a compact authored hierarchy with real icons/silhouettes, aligned before-to-after values for at most three decision-relevant deltas, restrained consequence copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad navigation/focus feedback. Preserve exactly-once choice commits and paused-world transaction semantics.
tasks.title: Make weapon identity, automatic combat, and upgrade choices truthful

done_when: The ordinary route advances through five authored waves with visible wave ids/titles and composition changes: forgiving Wave 1 teaching, fast flank pressure in Wave 2, ranged lane plus first elite in Wave 3, mixed representative density with an escape choice in Wave 4, and Bellkeeper plus controlled support crowd in Wave 5.

Boss entry is clearly signaled, spawns exactly once at the configured milestone, exposes readable health/telegraphs/phases, and supports damage, defeat, victory/result, and failure transitions without soft-locking.
Spawn cadence, live cap, budget, archetype weights, and navigation remain data-driven and safe relative to the traversable arena; no spawning continues after victory or failure.
Restart disposes or resets enemies, boss, timers, pause reasons, signals, seed, and result flags so a fresh run begins cleanly after either boss victory or ordinary failure.
tasks.instructions: Complete the authoritative wave/run contract in MournlightWaveDirector, EncounterSpawner, BellkeeperActor, and RunController. Bind the wave resource's elapsed timing, spawn budgets/caps, role weights, elite warnings, and Bellkeeper milestone to HUD/audio/VFX cues. Ensure enemy spawn lanes respect the cemetery collision and navigation boundaries, boss telegraphs and phase changes are readable, and terminal victory/failure/result/retry transitions are single-shot and replayable.
tasks.title: Deliver five-wave progression, Bellkeeper boss, and clean lifecycle
